annotatedSteps.description: Subtracting remainders to determine the required numbers and their prime factorisation
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Remainders must be subtracted first: 85 − 1 = 84 and 72 − 2 = 70.

annotatedSteps.description: Calculating the HCF and concluding the greatest number
annotatedSteps.studentWork:
There is no common prime factor, so HCF(85, 72) = 1.
∴ The greatest number is 1.
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × HCF must be calculated for 84 and 70, which gives 14.

teacherNote: Marked against: Subtracting the remainders from given numbers: 85 − 1 = 84 and 72 − 2 = 70 (1); Finding HCF(84 / 70) = 14 and concluding the greatest number is 14 (1). When a problem asks for the greatest number dividing given numbers leaving specific remainders, you must subtract the remainders first: 85 − 1 = 84 and 72 − 2 = 70. Finding the HCF of 84 and 70 then gives the correct divisor, 14.
